show.description: When airline tycoon Veer Chopra falls for the charming flight attendant Lara Smith, he thinks he has found his perfect match. But when his unsuspecting parents, Rajesh and Vinita Chopra, fly in to meet their future daughter-in-law, a shocking web of arrogance, deception, and humiliation unfolds mid-air turning love into the costliest mistake of Veer’s life.
